labs.title: LangChain Practical Labs
labs.description: LangChain is a framework for building LLM applications. Learn to connect LLMs to tools, memory, and custom data sources.

labs.title: AI-Native Vector Database with Weaviate & Ollama
labs.description: Install Weaviate locally with Docker and Ollama, generate embeddings, and build semantic search workflows.

labs.title: Data Quality Metrics for Large Language Models
labs.description: A comprehensive framework for assessing and improving the quality of training data for large language models.

labs.title: Ethical Considerations in Synthetic Data Generation
labs.description: Addressing privacy, bias, and fairness concerns in the creation and use of synthetic datasets for AI training.

labs.title: LLM Evaluation Framework
labs.description: Open source methodology for evaluating large language models across accuracy, reasoning, and domain benchmarks.

labs.title: Reinforcement Learning Lab
labs.description: Developing intelligent agents that learn optimal decision-making strategies through interaction with their environment.

labs.title: ML 101: A Gentle Introduction
labs.description: Fundamental concepts of machine learning with an accompanying interactive Jupyter notebook for hands-on learning.

labs.title: Data Science & ML Core Libraries Architecture
labs.description: Comprehensive guide to modern Python data science libraries: NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, CV, PyTorch, and Keras 3 with Pele architecture diagrams.

labs.title: Complete NumPy Tutorial: Beginner to Advanced with Python Labs
labs.description: Learn NumPy with simple Python examples, practical exercises, and modern 2.x APIs: ndarrays, slicing, broadcasting, random distributions, linear algebra, memory performance, and attention math.

labs.title: Before GPU Engineering: Hardware Architecture, Memory Physics & The Roofline Model
labs.description: Deconstruct GPU engineering from first principles: silicon die allocation, memory hierarchy latencies, arithmetic intensity, warp execution, and why LLM decoding is memory-bound.

labs.title: SciPy Complete Guide: Beginner to Intermediate Scientific Python
labs.description: Master numerical computing with SciPy: optimization, linear algebra, integration, ODEs, interpolation, hypothesis testing, FFT signal processing, sparse arrays, and spatial KDTree.

labs.title: Pandas Complete Guide: From DataFrames to SQL Joins and Analytics
labs.description: Master tabular data analytics with pandas: loc/iloc, CSV cleaning, GroupBy aggregations, SQL-style joins, time series resampling, pivot/melt, SQLite comparison, and Copy-on-Write.

labs.title: Matplotlib Complete Guide: Python Charts, Figures & Five Hands-On Labs
labs.description: Master visual storytelling with Matplotlib: Figure and Axes anatomy, lines, scatter, bar charts, distributions, subplot mosaics, tick formatting, heatmaps, and publication export.

labs.title: Seaborn Complete Guide: Statistical Visualizations and Five Python Labs
labs.description: Master high-level statistical graphics with Seaborn: distributions (histplot, KDE, ECDF), categorical variance (box, strip, violin), bivariate associations, correlation heatmaps, FacetGrid, and themes.

labs.title: Scikit-learn Complete Guide: Beginner to Intermediate
labs.description: Master classical machine learning with scikit-learn: Estimator API (fit/predict/transform), stratified splits, precision/recall/ROC AUC, Ridge regression diagnostics, ColumnTransformer pipelines, GridSearchCV tuning, KMeans, PCA, and production safety.

labs.title: XGBoost Complete Guide: 10 Lessons + 5 Python Labs
labs.description: Master gradient-boosted decision trees with XGBoost: objective optimization, binary classification, regression residuals, native DMatrix, early stopping without data leakage, hist vs exact tree methods, native categoricals, and JSON model deployment.

labs.title: LightGBM Complete Learning Guide: 10 Lessons + 5 Python Labs
labs.description: Master gradient-boosted decision trees with LightGBM: histogram binning, leaf-wise vs level-wise growth, LGBMClassifier, LGBMRegressor, native Dataset and Booster, leakage-free early stopping callbacks, native pandas categorical features, GridSearchCV tuning, and Booster text model serialization.

labs.title: CatBoost Complete Guide: Python Tutorial, Pool, Categories & Five ML Labs
labs.description: Master gradient-boosted decision trees with CatBoost: oblivious/symmetric decision trees, native Pool container, robust string categorical feature encoding, missing value imputation, leakage-free early stopping, manual StratifiedKFold CV tuning, and native CBM model serialization.

labs.title: Complete Pillow Guide — Python Image Processing, Examples and Labs
labs.description: Master raster image processing in Python with Pillow: open/save across PNG/JPEG/WebP, proportional resizing with contain, fit and pad, RGBA alpha compositing, spatial filters and ImageEnhance, ImageDraw typography, EXIF normalization, batch processing, and defensive upload validation.

labs.title: OpenCV Python Complete Guide — 10 Lessons and 5 Computer Vision Labs
labs.description: Master computer vision in Python with OpenCV: BGR/RGB/HSV/LAB color spaces, Gaussian and median spatial filters, Sobel and Canny edge detection, Otsu thresholding and contour hierarchies, four-point perspective homography transforms, and multi-frame video object tracking.

labs.title: scikit-image Complete Guide: Scientific Image Processing in Python
labs.description: Master scientific image processing in Python with scikit-image: RGB vs grayscale conversions, floating-point dynamic range normalization, Gaussian and Canny edge filtering, Otsu thresholding, footprint morphology, connected component regionprops morphometry, distance transform watershed segmentation, and 3D volumetric analysis.

labs.title: PyTorch Complete Guide — Tensors, Autograd, Neural Networks & Transformer Basics
labs.description: Master deep learning fundamentals in PyTorch: tensor striding and memory layout, dynamic autograd computation graphs, nn.Module layer construction, mini-batch DataLoader pipelines, 2D CNN image classification, token embedding NLP with masked mean pooling, and causal multihead self-attention transformer blocks.

labs.title: TorchVision Complete Guide — 10 Lessons and 5 Hands-on Labs
labs.description: Master computer vision engineering with TorchVision: CHW tensor representations, ImageFolder dataset hierarchies, modern transforms.v2 compositions, data augmentation without label leakage, make_grid visual debugging, TinyVisionCNN training and validation checkpointing, Model Zoo weight inspection, and TVTensors synchronized bounding boxes and masks.

labs.title: TensorFlow Complete Guide — Beginner to Deployment
labs.description: Master deep learning systems with TensorFlow 2.x and Keras 3: static vs dynamic computational graphs, tf.Tensor and NHWC memory layouts, tf.GradientTape automatic differentiation, Keras Sequential and Functional architectures, high-performance tf.data pipelines (batch, prefetch, map), early stopping and validation splits, 2D CNN classification on synthetic shapes, SavedModel serialization with serving signatures, and LiteRT (TFLite) mobile and edge deployment with dynamic-range quantization.

labs.title: Keras 3 Complete Guide — From Python Tensors to Multi-Backend AI
labs.description: Master deep learning architecture with Keras 3 multi-backend execution across PyTorch, JAX, and TensorFlow, symbolic KerasTensor vs concrete backend tensors, backend-agnostic mathematical operations with keras.ops, Sequential vs Functional model graphs, reliable 3-way dataset partitioning (train/val/test) with EarlyStopping, 2D CNN classification on channels-last synthetic vision fixtures, token embeddings and multi-head self-attention, backend-neutral custom layers with @register_keras_serializable, safe .keras model persistence, and deployment export pathways.
